messages:
sam: deploybot popped an alert for canary latency on v4.0.0 (us-east). p95 ~1.2s, threshold 350ms. traffic slice 8%. auto-revert disabled due to evening release window. thoughts?
olivia: hmm. two options: full rollback of canary slice or pin canary to v3.9.x and swap to the low-latency model-variant for canary. Which has less risk?
maya: swapping to the smaller variant (quantized-llama-q4) might reduce latency without reverting code. but need to ensure compatibility (no function-calls change).
deploybot: [ALERT] canary_latency_threshold breach (alert cb-8021). auto-revert suppressed by policy (release-window). metrics: p95=1220ms, errors normal.
sam: is there any enterprise traffic on that slice?
maya: looks like one dedicated sandbox customer only. no SLA customers routed.
ryan-cs: if you plan to swap variants, i'll draft a one-paragraph customer status and hold until confirm.
olivia: action proposal: 1) pin canary route to previous stable tag v3.9.4 for control, 2) attempt variant-swap on canary to quantized model, 3) if variant swap fails / compatibility issues, run rollback-script for canary to v3.9.4. agree?
sam: +1. pin first to avoid flapping. i'll pin route now: `redwood route pin --route=canary --version=v3.9.4 --who=sam`
deploybot: [ACTION] Route pinned by sam at 4799990020. pinned version: v3.9.4.
maya: initiating model-variant swap: `infra swap-variant --route=canary --variant=llama-q4-lowlat --region=us-east` Starting 22:10 UTC.
deploybot: [ACTION] Variant swap started by maya at 4799990030. Progress logs: ok->warm->active.
maya: swap complete. p95 dropped to ~320ms immediately. verifying logs for incorrect outputs.
olivia: excellent. ryan, customer blurb?
ryan-cs: "We detected increased latency on a small canary slice after the v4.0.0 deploy. We pinned the canary to the previous stable version and temporarily switched the canary to a lower-latency model variant while we investigate. No customer data affected. We'll share updates in the postmortem." posting after you confirm timestamps.
ops-bot: Monitoring: 10m rolling p95 stable at 310-340ms; error rate unchanged.
sam: ok closing actions: leave pin in place for 2h then roll forward with fix or unpin if stable. create ticket: PM-4521 "investigate v4.0.0 canary p95 spike - kvcache vs kernel" assigned to eng-ml.
maya: ticket created and linked. thanks team.
olivia: follow-up: update release-notes with entry "canary pinned + variant swap for latency mitigation" and tag commit #mitigation-479999.
ryan-cs: customer note queued. will post now.
sam: thanks. monitoring continues; will re-open thread if anything else crops up."
